notablePrerequisites:
Soldevi Adnate does not have summoning sickness.
You control another nontoken Knight that can be cast using only black mana.
description:
Activate Soldevi Adnate by tapping it and sacrificing any other nontoken Knight that can be cast using only black mana, adding an amount of {B} equal to that creature's mana value.
Cast the Knight from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
The Knight enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
